description: This file contains a PHP class definition for handling XML files, including reading, writing, creating, and manipulating XML structures in memory. It defines classes for XML tags and the XML file as a whole, with methods for parsing XML strings/files and generating XML output.

classes.name: XMLTag
classes.description: Represents an individual XML tag, including its name, attributes, CDATA, and subtags. Provides methods for adding/removing subtags and attributes, writing the tag to a file, and searching for subtags by name.

classes.name: XMLFile
classes.description: Represents an entire XML document, managing parsing, creating, and writing XML files. Provides methods to read from strings or file handles, generate XML content, and cleanup resources.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for XMLTag and XMLFile classes, initializing attributes such as version, encoding, root tag, and current tag.

methods.name: add_subtag
methods.description: Adds a new subtag with a specified name and optional attributes to the current tag.

methods.name: find_subtags_by_name
methods.description: Searches the subtags of the current tag for those matching a given name, case-insensitive.

methods.name: clear_subtags
methods.description: Removes all subtags from the current tag, recursively clearing their parent references.

methods.name: remove_subtag
methods.description: Removes a specific subtag by index.

methods.name: num_subtags
methods.description: Returns the number of subtags of the current tag.

methods.name: add_attribute
methods.description: Adds or sets an attribute for the current tag.

methods.name: clear_attributes
methods.description: Removes all attributes from the current tag.

methods.name: set_name
methods.description: Sets the name of the current tag.

methods.name: set_attributes
methods.description: Sets multiple attributes for the current tag.

methods.name: add_cdata
methods.description: Adds character data to the current tag.

methods.name: clear_cdata
methods.description: Clears character data from the current tag.

methods.name: write_file_handle
methods.description: Serializes the current tag and its subtags to a file handle as well-formed XML.

methods.name: read_xml_string
methods.description: Parses XML content from a string, building the internal tag structure.

methods.name: read_file_handle
methods.description: Reads and parses XML data from a file handle, constructing the internal XML tag structure.

methods.name: write_file_handle
methods.description: Serializes the entire XML document to a file handle.

methods.name: _tag_open
methods.description: Internal callback for handling opening XML tags during parsing.

methods.name: _tag_close
methods.description: Internal callback for handling closing XML tags during parsing.

methods.name: _cdata
methods.description: Internal callback for handling character data during parsing.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Prepares the XML structure for destruction by clearing subtags and breaking reference cycles.
